page.overview:
Who is Bremor?

Bremor works on the festival tower for the Carnival of Time in Clock Town with the other carpenters. When spoken to, he wonders if Brac is working in the evening and if his tasks will be finished. By the third day, he is atop the festival tower until the evening, when he evacuates with the remaining townspeople. If Link successfully defeats the evil spirit within Majora's Mask, Bremor is seen cheering in Termina Field with other townspeople.

After obtains the , can be found standing next to the in , where he expresses his desire to cheer up . Once has filled the blue-roofed with a tenant, will with , resulting in being inspired to build a brand-new that can then be occupied by a second tenant.

After a successful , he will express his gratitude that has gone back to normal. After this, disappears from and does not make another appearance for the remainder of the game.
